answer.summary: A new, narrow research question is proposed to investigate whether memory retention in agents can be measured through the consistency of state representation under minimal input variation over time without perturbations.
answer.content: Examine Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 for explicit descriptions of memory retention mechanisms under stable, low-variation input conditions; if any exist, define the longest observed duration without detectable state decay as an anchor for baseline persistence claims. This focuses on stability in the absence of perturbations to isolate intrinsic retention mechanisms from external influence.
